capabilities: Embed note text and cache vectors per file
Pair notes by cosine similarity above a threshold
Verify candidate pairs with an LLM chat model
Show confirmed contradictions in a side panel with clickable note links
Connect to any OpenAI-compatible endpoint including local servers
extras: Not in the community plugin store; requires building from source and manual installation. Privacy warning: note titles and the first part of each note body are sent to the configured LLM endpoint, so a local endpoint is advised for sensitive vaults; a hosted provider may require a paid account.
motivation: The author built it because knowledge bases drift and two notes written months apart can end up asserting opposite things.
problem: Knowledge bases drift, so notes written months apart can assert opposite things and Obsidian gives no way to surface those conflicts.

relations.evidence: Works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint — OpenAI, Ollama, LM Studio.
leave the key empty for local servers such as Ollama or LM Studio

summary: Vault scanner that pairs similar notes via embeddings and uses an LLM to verify and report contradictory claims between them.
